spec.title: Simple Stopwatch
spec.description: Stopwatch with hundredths, accurate timestamp-based timing, laps, pause and reset.
spec.source: const event=input.event;const prev=input.state;function pad(n,w){var s=String(Math.floor(n));while(s.length<w){s='0'+s;}return s;}function fmt(ms){var t=Math.floor(ms);if(!isFinite(t)||t<0){t=0;}var h=Math.floor(t/3600000);var m=Math.floor(t/60000)%60;var s=Math.floor(t/1000)%60;var cs=Math.floor((t%1000)/10);return pad(h,2)+':'+pad(m,2)+':'+pad(s,2)+'.'+pad(cs,2);}var ui={'type':'theme','preset':'technical','children':[{'type':'column','children':[{'type':'metric','text':'Elapsed time','bind':'elapsedText','style':{'emphasis':'number'}},{'type':'text','text':'Status','bind':'statusText','style':{'tone':'muted'}},{'type':'flowRow','children':[{'type':'button','text':'Start','action':'startStopwatch','variant':'filled','enabledBind':'notRunning'},{'type':'button','text':'Pause','action':'pauseStopwatch','enabledBind':'running'},{'type':'button','text':'Lap','action':'recordLap','enabledBind':'running'},{'type':'button','text':'Reset','action':'resetStopwatch','variant':'text','enabledBind':'notRunning'}]},{'type':'text','text':'Laps','style':{'emphasis':'title'}},{'type':'list','text':'Laps','bind':'laps','columns':[{'text':'Lap','field':'label'},{'text':'Split','field':'split'},{'text':'Total','field':'total'}],'emptyText':'No laps recorded yet.'}]}]};var timers=[{id:'tick',intervalMs:50}];var now=Date.now();var next=prev;if(event.type==='timer'){if(event.timerId==='tick'&&prev.running){var e1=prev.accumulatedMs+(now-prev.startAt);next=Object.assign({},prev,{elapsedMs:e1,elapsedText:fmt(e1)});}}else if(event.type==='action'){var a=event.actionId;if(a==='startStopwatch'){if(!prev.running){next=Object.assign({},prev,{running:true,notRunning:false,startAt:now,statusText:'Running',elapsedMs:prev.accumulatedMs,elapsedText:fmt(prev.accumulatedMs)});}}else if(a==='pauseStopwatch'){if(prev.running){var acc=prev.accumulatedMs+(now-prev.startAt);next=Object.assign({},prev,{running:false,notRunning:true,startAt:0,accumulatedMs:acc,elapsedMs:acc,elapsedText:fmt(acc),statusText:'Paused'});}}else if(a==='recordLap'){if(prev.running){var total=prev.accumulatedMs+(now-prev.startAt);var laps=prev.laps.slice();var last=laps.length>0?laps[laps.length-1].totalMs:0;var split=total-last;if(laps.length<100){laps.push({id:'lap-'+now+'-'+(laps.length+1),label:'Lap '+(laps.length+1),split:fmt(split),total:fmt(total),totalMs:total});}next=Object.assign({},prev,{laps:laps,elapsedMs:total,elapsedText:fmt(total)});}}else if(a==='resetStopwatch'){if(!prev.running){next=Object.assign({},prev,{accumulatedMs:0,startAt:0,elapsedMs:0,elapsedText:fmt(0),laps:[],statusText:'Ready'});}}}return {state:next,ui:ui,timers:timers};
